note: A single pull-in dirt site in full sun on Pete's Run Road, about 0.9 mile from PA 144 north of Fish Dam Overlook; other forest roads reach it too. The agency describes it as traditionally a hunting campsite near Gravel Lick Trail and Petes Run with a minor overlook, and lists a 300-ft dirt driveway. Stone fire ring; no table, toilet or water. The agency cautions that it is reached by remote dirt or gravel forest roads that may not suit low-clearance vehicles or large RVs. Pack out trash. --Claude
summary: Site page re-read: CR016 still listed, Drive-In, RV/Tent/Trailer categories, max vehicle 25 ft (equipment length 35), dirt pull-in; count 1 and 25 ft confirmed, pull_through false added. Season year-round confirmed; sells in all three windows (some November nights reserved). Fees confirmed, $6.50 reservation fee added; hookups and facilities none. Imagery (Esri leaf-on and PASDA leaf-off): pin sits on a small gravel pull-off where a lane leaves Pete's Run Road northward; pin not moved. NHD: nothing within 200 m; not waterfront.
flags: Agency access statements (ruling 11: nothing measured): 'Caution: This campsite is accessed by remote state forest dirt or gravel roads and may not be suitable for some low-clearance vehicles or large RVs.' No driveway grade is given; no Severe grade, 4WD, wet-weather or clearance statement on the site page. Kept. Boilerplate on every Sproul page, not site-specific: 'State forest roads are not maintained in the winter and often become snow covered, icy and potentially impassable' and '4WD vehicles may be recommended for some sites year-round, check notes' (this site's notes say nothing about 4WD).

Page oddity: 'Hike In Distance to Site: 300' and 'Distance from parking lot to site: Less than 300 feet' sit beside 'Site Access: Drive-In', 'Driveway Length: 300' and an RV Site category. Read as a 300-ft driveway, not a walk-in; the DCNR GIS record says TrailerAccess 'Yes' ('New site for Aspira', edited 2023-05-05). Not treated as hike-in.

ATV check (ruling 1): the DCNR Sproul roadside-campsites map (05/02/2025) draws the CR-series sites as ordinary roadside campsites and shows the 'Whiskey Springs ATV Area Campsites' (WS series) as a separate inset; this site is not one of them and no agency page places it in an ATV parking lot. The Sproul advisories page does warn 'Stay Alert for ATVs on Roads' (the Northcentral Regional ATV Trail uses some forest roads). Kept.

Sproul advisories page (read 2026-11-10): no closure or restriction on this site's road; it carries the Bloody Skillet Orviston-lot section closure, the indefinite Left Branch Young Womans Creek Road closure, 'Stay Alert for ATVs on Roads', a dust advisory and a firewood-cutting road list.

NAME: the '(Cooks Run)' in the stored name is only the booking system's loop label ('Site, Loop: CR016, Cooks Run'). It is on Pete's Run Road, about 0.9 mile off PA 144 north of Fish Dam Overlook. Suggest a name that says where it is; apply.py does not write names.

Agency pages disagree on the district's own inventory: the Sproul camping page says 'Sproul State Forest offers nine roadside campsites for overnight camping in RVs. No tent camping permitted. Self-contained toilets are required.' while the district's 2025 map labels CR001-CR021 plus the WS series, and the CR booking pages list 'Tent Site, Trailer Site'. Nothing here depends on it.
